anti_false_merge.detail: Two simultaneous alerts across disjoint topologies produced 2 distinct incidents and ServiceNow tickets.

out_of_order_arrival.detail: Symptom alert arriving first was correctly superseded when upstream root cause arrived.

tenant_boundary_isolation.detail: Different tenants on the same microservice were isolated into independent incidents.

circular_dependency_guardrail.detail: Topology cycle traversal terminated deterministically without infinite loop.

single_isolated_alert.detail: Single alert cleanly processed as standalone root cause with 0 symptoms.
